The *Sanidassanattika, Cittasahabhūduka* (Patthana 16.71) is a canonical Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and final treatise of the Abhidhamma Piṭaka. Within the intricate relational matrices of the *Paṭṭhāna*, this section cross-tabulates the *Sanidassana-ttika* (the triad of phenomena that are visible and with impact, invisible and with impact, or invisible and without impact) with the *Cittasahabhū-duka* (the dyad of states that co-exist or arise together with consciousness and those that do not).
